all_pool_feed.long: Antetokounmpo is one of several projected starters who won't be available for this preseason matchup. This is likely a rest-related move in order to have Antetokounmpo available for the regular-season opener on Oct. 21 against the Timberwolves, especially since he was limited to just 36 regular-season games with the Bucks in the 2025-26 regular season. His next chance to play will come against Brooklyn on Wednesday.

all_pool_feed.name: Davion Mitchell
all_pool_feed.short: Mitchell (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: The Heat will be resting their entire starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game, so expect ample minutes for guys like Ryan Conwell and Bez Mbeng. Mitchell should return for Wednesday's exhibition against the Nets.

all_pool_feed.name: Dru Smith
all_pool_feed.short: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
all_pool_feed.long: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he indeed misses a couple weeks, he could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.

all_pool_feed.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
all_pool_feed.short: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's preseason game against Charlotte, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD in Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota. He logged 18 minutes in the two-point win over OKC on Wednesday. However, Jakucionis will take a seat once again Sunday, with his next opportunity to play coming Wednesday versus Chicago.

all_pool_feed.name: Brayden Burries
all_pool_feed.short: Burries will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets due to a coach's decision, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Burries played well in Milwaukee's preseason game Wednesday, logging 16 points, five rebounds, two steals and an assist in 21 minutes, but he will sit out of Sunday's matchup with the Hornets. His next opportunity to play comes Wednesday against the Bulls.

all_pool_feed.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
all_pool_feed.short: Shannon (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
all_pool_feed.long: Shannon will be unavailable at Madison Square Garden after starting Saturday against the Heat. Across three preseason games, the wing is averaging 11.3 points, 3.3 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 18.5 minutes per contest.

all_pool_feed.name: Jonathan Kuminga
all_pool_feed.short: Kuminga (general soreness) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
all_pool_feed.long: "[Kuminga] is dealing with a little bit of bumps and bruises that we're just being overly cautious with," said head coach Chris Finch when asked why Kuminga would miss Monday's exhibition. It sounds like there's a decent chance Kuminga will be able to get back out there for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Pistons.

all_pool_feed.name: Donte DiVincenzo
all_pool_feed.short: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

all_pool_feed.name: Dejounte Murray
all_pool_feed.short: Murray (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Heat, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Murray is dealing with a right toe contusion, though head coach Jamahl Mosley said his absence Thursday is precautionary. The veteran point guard's next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against Dallas.

all_pool_feed.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
all_pool_feed.short: Towns ended with 11 points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), four assists, two rebounds and one steal over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to Minnesota. He won't play Tuesday against Toronto for rest purposes, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Towns was solid, if unspectacular, as New York fell to 0-3 in preseason play. The standout center has played in each of the first three contests but will take a seat for the second half of the back-to-back set Tuesday at Toronto. Towns' next chance to suit up will come Thursday at home against the Raptors.

all_pool_feed.name: Mikal Bridges
all_pool_feed.short: Bridges finished with nine points (3-6 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds and two assists over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.
all_pool_feed.long: According to Stefan Bondy of The New York Post, Mike Brown said that he will hold out his regular starters for Tuesday's game in Toronto for rest purposes. With Bridges and the rest of the first unit unavailable, Jordan Clarkson might see a large uptick in usage.

all_pool_feed.name: Josh Hart
all_pool_feed.short: Hart recorded two points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt), three rebounds, three assists and one steal over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.
all_pool_feed.long: Per Stefan Bondy of The New York Post, Hart will sit out Tuesday's exhibition for rest, as it is the second night of a back-to-back set during the preseason. Hart's absence should open up minutes for Landry Shamet and Jordan Clarkson.

all_pool_feed.name: OG Anunoby
all_pool_feed.short: Anunoby totaled 15 points (4-8 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), three steals, two rebounds and one assist over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to Minnesota. He won't play Tuesday against Toronto for rest purposes, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Anunoby put forth a solid scoring effort, fueled by perfection at the charity stripe, while also tallying a team-high three steals in the loss. The veteran wing has scored in double figures in each of his three preseason appearances, but he'll be inactive for the second half of the back-to-back set Tuesday at Toronto. Anunoby's next chance to suit up will come Thursday, also against the Raptors.

all_pool_feed.name: Jalen Brunson
all_pool_feed.short: Brunson (rest) won't suit up for Tuesday's preseason game in Toronto, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
all_pool_feed.long: It's the second night of a back-to-back set in the preseason, so the Knicks will sit out their entire starting unit. Expect more minutes for Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek.

all_pool_feed.name: Jaylin Williams
all_pool_feed.short: Williams (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Williams is still dealing with a heel injury and won't play in the second half of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to see game action ahead of the regular season will come Thursday against Houston.

all_pool_feed.name: Chet Holmgren
all_pool_feed.short: Holmgren (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Holmgren has yet to play in the preseason due to a quad contusion and will remain on the inactive list in the second leg of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to suit up before the regular season will come Thursday versus Houston.

all_pool_feed.name: Ajay Mitchell
all_pool_feed.short: Mitchell (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Mitchell is out for both ends of this back-to-back set. His next chance to play is Thursday against the Rockets.

all_pool_feed.name: Nikola Vucevic
all_pool_feed.short: Vucevic (rest) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers.
all_pool_feed.long: It appears to be a routine maintenance day for the veteran big man. Friday's matchup versus the Heat marks his next chance to play.

all_pool_feed.name: Anthony Black
all_pool_feed.short: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against Cleveland, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Black has yet to play this preseason and will remain on the inactive list Tuesday with a sprained right ankle. His last chance to play ahead of the regular season will come Friday against Miami.

all_pool_feed.name: Dominick Barlow
all_pool_feed.short: Barlow (back) was unable to practice Tuesday, Noah Levick of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Barlow has missed the entire preseason so far and remains without a timetable to return. He can be considered questionable at best for Friday's preseason finale against Boston.

all_pool_feed.name: Adem Bona
all_pool_feed.short: Bona (foot) practiced in a limited fashion Monday, per Ky Carlin of USA Today.
all_pool_feed.long: Bona is already expected to miss Friday's preseason finale against Boston, but he's still aiming to be ready for the start of the regular season. Once healthy, Bona is in line to serve as the No. 2 center behind Joel Embiid.

all_pool_feed.name: Anfernee Simons
all_pool_feed.short: Simons (hamstring) was limited at Monday's practice, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Simons continues to deal with tightness in his hamstring, though he's trending in the right direction. For now, he's questionable at best for the next preseason game Oct. 16 against the Celtics.

all_pool_feed.name: LeBron James
all_pool_feed.short: James (rest) won't be available for Saturday's preseason contest against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: The Sixers will be resting several players for this contest, and James is one of the many projected starters who will be taking a seat alongside Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown. The 76ers will manage James' workload carefully with an eye toward having him ready for the regular-season opener against the Knicks on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

all_pool_feed.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
all_pool_feed.short: Caldwell-Pope (rest) won't play in Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: LeBron James (rest), Joel Embiid (rest) and Jaylen Brown (rest) will join Caldwell-Pope on the inactive list for Saturday's exhibition, which may result in major minutes for Rayan Rupert and Caleb Love. Caldwell-Pope's next chance to play will come Friday in a rematch with the Celtics.

all_pool_feed.name: Jaylen Brown
all_pool_feed.short: Brown (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game in Boston, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Brown will skip his first meeting against his former team in Boston, but he should be able to get back out there for Friday's rematch with the Celtics. Justin Edwards and Dean Wade will help pick up the slack Saturday with Brown unavailable.

all_pool_feed.name: Joel Embiid
all_pool_feed.short: Embiid (rest) is out for Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

all_pool_feed.name: Devin Booker

all_pool_feed.name: Miles Bridges
all_pool_feed.short: Bridges (ankle) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs, Hayden Cilley of ClutchPoints.com reports.
all_pool_feed.long: While Bridges won't play Saturday, he was able to practice Friday, so he's trending in the right direction. His next chance to suit up will come Wednesday in a preseason rematch with the Spurs.

all_pool_feed.name: Mark Williams
all_pool_feed.short: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
all_pool_feed.long: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.

all_pool_feed.name: Shaedon Sharpe
all_pool_feed.short: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
all_pool_feed.long: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.

all_pool_feed.name: Precious Achiuwa
all_pool_feed.short: Precious Achiuwa exited Tuesday's game with a right ankle injury and did not return, per Jason Anderson of the Sacramento Bee.
all_pool_feed.long: Achiuwa started at center and posted a double-double before leaving late with a right ankle injury and being ruled out. With Maxime Raynaud (knee) and Dylan Cardwell (calf) each expected to miss at least two weeks, the severity of the ankle injury matters a lot for Sacramento's frontcourt depth.

With both Sabonis and Maxime Raynaud (knee) unavailable, the Kings will need to rely on other frontcourt options against the Trail Blazers. Sabonis' next opportunity to suit up will come Friday against San Antonio.

all_pool_feed.name: Zach LaVine
all_pool_feed.short: LaVine (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

all_pool_feed.name: Dylan Cardwell
all_pool_feed.short: Cardwell will miss at least two weeks with a left calf strain, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Sacramento's frontcourt takes another blow after losing Maxime Raynaud (knee) for several weeks over the weekend. The Kings figure to depend heavily upon Domantas Sabonis at center to open the season, while Precious Achiuwa should play a featured role off the bench to help pick up the slack.

The big man will still begin the regular season on the inactive list, leaving additional minutes available for the likes of Precious Achiuwa and Dylan Cardwell (rest).

all_pool_feed.name: Tobias Harris
all_pool_feed.short: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said they will not rush Tobias Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
all_pool_feed.long: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in danger of missing opening night. His absence will open up minutes for Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes.

all_pool_feed.name: Kyle Filipowski
all_pool_feed.short: Jazz head coach Will Hardy said Saturday that Filipowski is progressing well and doing the necessary steps to get back on the court, but the big man doesn't have a return timeline, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Filipowski tweaked his back while lifting in the 2025-26 offseason, which caused painful sciatica down his leg throughout the campaign and limited his explosiveness. This offseason, he underwent surgery to fix the herniated disc in his back that was causing the pain, and he's still rehabbing. With Jusuf Nurkic (foot) slated to miss Opening Night, Filipowski's availability moving forward will be one to monitor closely.

all_pool_feed.name: Jusuf Nurkic
all_pool_feed.short: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
all_pool_feed.long: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.
